title: Renkin San-kyuu Magical? Pokaan Specials
justification: AniList 1489 (SPECIAL, 3 episode(s) from 2006-06-23) is AniDB 4144's special(s) S1-S3, aired 2006-06-23 to 2006-10-25. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 4144. The parent node has no mapping rows, so S1-S3 default to TVDB 0x1-0x3.
